_schema.comment: Phase E: BD-curated creator database for the audit's creator-partnership action. Engineering owns schema correctness; BD owns row correctness (which creators cover which categories, recent coverage of competitor brands, current contact info).

fields.display_name: Creator's public name as it appears on their channel
fields.platform: youtube | instagram | tiktok | substack | podcast | blog
fields.category_tags: List of merchant categories this creator covers (sleepwear, fashion, beauty, home, fitness, wellness, etc.)
fields.audience_size_band: micro (<10k) | small (10k-100k) | medium (100k-1M) | large (>1M) — band, not exact
fields.recent_coverage: List of competitor brand names this creator has covered in the last 12 months (extracted from PR-F failed_query data + BD-verified)
fields.contact_url: URL or mailto: target — what the merchant clicks to reach them
fields.sample_brief_template: Pre-filled outreach brief the merchant can copy/paste, with {merchant_brand} / {recent_competitor} placeholders
fields.last_verified_at: ISO8601 — when BD last confirmed the creator is active + categories are current. Engineers should warn when older than 6 months.

ranking_signals.competitor_overlap: creator.recent_coverage intersects audit's competitor_brands (0.5 per match)
ranking_signals.audience_fit: merchants <$5M revenue match small/medium creators best (0.3 weight when in band)

hard_rules: Do NOT invent creator names. The matcher returns zero results when the database is empty — better to surface no creator-partnership action than to fabricate candidates.
Do NOT ship more than 1-2 obviously-fake placeholder entries (creator_id starting with 'example_'). The matcher excludes example_* IDs from production matches.
BD must verify last_verified_at is within 6 months before re-shipping. Stale rows degrade trust.

creators.sample_brief_template: Hi [creator], I'm reaching out about {merchant_brand}. We saw your recent coverage of {recent_competitor} and think our products would fit your audience. [TODO: 1-2 sentence pitch]
